test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 41

questions.question: Six friends, L, M, N, O, P and S, are sitting around a circular table, but not necessarily in the same order, and are facing the centre of the table. S is an immediate neighbour of both N and O. N sits third to the right of M. L sits second to the right of M. Who sits to the immediate left of P?
In a certain code language, ‘CLAN’ is coded as ‘9865’ and ‘LOAN’ is coded as ‘6485’. What is the code for ‘O’ in the given code language?

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left) 642 798 529 349 942 (Right)(Example - 697 – first digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)(NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.)If all the numbers are arranged in ascending order, the position of how many numbers will remain unchanged?

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement:The students of school X lost 14 out of 20 hockey games that they played this season.Reasons:I) The students of school X play cricket better than hockey.II) The sports coach of school X retired last year, and the school is still trying to find a suitable person to fill his post.
options: Both I and II are possible reasons.
Only II is a possible reason.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Only II is a possible reason.) है।

questions.question: Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)17 - 68 - 51 - 3421 - 84 - 63 - 42

Each of E, F, G, H, K, L and M has an exam on a different day of the week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. F has an exam on Friday. Only two people have an exam between L and F. Only four people have an exam between E and L. G has an exam immediately after H. M doesn’t have an exam on Monday. How many people have an exam between M and K?

Town C is to the west of town A. Town D is to the south of town C. Town B is to the east of town D. Town E is to the north of town B. Town A is to the south-west of town E. What is the position of town E with respect to town D?
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?A, V, Q, L, ?
Which numbers should come in place of the question marks (?) in the same sequence to make the series logically complete?4         7         15          30         54          ?

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)(12, 58, 43)(7, 73, 63)

In a certain code language,‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,‘A % B’ means ‘A is the father of B’ and‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.How is D related to K if ‘K – L × E % J – D + N’?
EBHT is related to FDKX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RBGS is related to SDJW. To which of the given options is YPBU related, following the same logic?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:
No animal is a pet.
All pets are babies.
No baby is an insect.

Conclusions:
(I) No insect is a pet.
(II) Some insects are animals.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion (I) follows.) है।

If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?35 A 7 B 9 D 15 C 16 = ?

D is the mother of C. C is the brother of E. E is the son of F. F is the brother of G. How is D related to G?

Seven boxes A, B, C, D, R, S and T are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only A is kept above C. Only S is kept between C and B. Only D is kept below T. How many boxes are kept between R and D?
